description: For an atom \(p\) whose two signed literals belong to \(L\cup R\), the specified atomic witness returns \(\bot\) when both literals lie in \(L\), \(\bar p\) when only the positive one lies in \(L\), \(p\) when only the negative one lies in \(L\), and \(\top\) when neither lies in \(L\). It includes the two exact primitive factor proofs and the common-vocabulary bound.
